text: How to use the Smeck A-I, PDF to HL7 converter.
On the home screen, drag a PDF into the drop zone, or click to browse. Up to ten files at once, ten megabytes each.
The converter handles six document types. Referrals — both specialist and GP. Results — pathology and radiology. Plus consent forms, and any generic medical PDF.
Files appear in the queue, ready to convert. For a single file, you can override the document type manually before converting.
Open Conversion Options to set the carrier, choose auto-file or queue-for-review, and optionally route the message to a specific BJC Health doctor.
Click Convert. Each PDF goes through Bedrock vision — patient details and routing are extracted, and an HL7 version two point four message is built.
Every HL7 file lands in the same Genie drop folder. The message itself tells Genie where to file it — incoming letters for referrals, pathology, or radiology — based on the document type.
Download the HL7 file from the queue, or let the auto-filer drop it straight into Genie.
That's it. Drop, convert, download. From PDF to Genie in seconds.
